summary: Enhance your skills with our Participatory Monitoring and Evaluation Course. Learn effective techniques to engage stakeholders and improve project outcomes.
lede: Participatory Monitoring and Evaluation is an inclusive approach that brings stakeholders into the monitoring and evaluation process as active contributors. By moving beyond top-down methods, it helps organizations gather meaningful data while strengthening ownership, accountability, and collaboration. This course covers the principles, tools, and techniques for designing PM&E systems that reflect what matters most. Through practical activities, real-world examples, and expert insights, you will learn to align monitoring with organizational goals, navigate stakeholder dynamics, and turn findings into actionable strategies.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals across sectors who want to master Participatory Monitoring and Evaluation techniques:
modules: Introduction to Participatory Monitoring and Evaluation
Advancing Equity and Inclusion in PM&E
Action Planning for Sustainable PM&E Practices
